results.title: Fed Govt Targets 25m Nigerians For Eye Care
results.content: The federal government has pledged to provide five million pairs of reading spectacles and 25,000 fully subsidised cataract surgeries by 2027 as part of efforts to tackle avoidable blindness. results.title: Persistent Headaches May Signal Brain Tumour – Neurosurgeon Warns
results.content: A neurosurgeon, Dr Charles Ugwuanyi, has warned Nigerians against dismissing persistent headaches as ordinary pain. He said they could sometimes be symptoms of serious medical conditions, including brain tumours and aneurysms.
